Under legacy semantics, `"auto"` (the default) resolves to `"multiindex"`, so `flat_snapshots` is false and the component-data context does not flatten snapshots. `create_model` still obtains `sns` through the unchanged `as_index` call and passes that same `sns` to the variable and constraint builders, just as base_commit does; changes inside builders do not change the snapshots handed to them.
